	.div_output_image_buttons {
		cursor:normal;
		display: none;
		position: absolute;
		left: 0;
		top: 50%;
		transform: translateY(-50%);
		width: 100%;
		text-align: center;
		z-index: 4;
		/* Buttons can wrap to multiple rows on wide cards (original behavior). On
		   narrow cards the @container rules below progressively HIDE the lowest-
		   priority buttons (last ones in DOM order: Publish, Use as mocap, Make
		   3D, Make video, Upscale ...) before they'd overflow. max-height:100%
		   + overflow:hidden is the last-line-of-defense clip if a browser doesn't
		   support container queries. */
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		justify-content: center;
		align-content: center;
		max-height: 100%;
		overflow: hidden;
		box-sizing: border-box;
		container-type: inline-size;
		container-name: hoverbtns;
	}
	/* Each button is ~52px wide + 14px margins ≈ 66px, so 4 fit per row at ~264px.
	   Buttons wrap to multiple rows; @container rules below hide the lowest-
	   priority buttons only when 2 rows of N can't fit anymore. The `of :not(...)`
	   clause makes nth-child count only buttons that aren't globally hidden, so
	   the K-th match is the K-th button actually showing on screen. Visible
	   priority order in DOM: Download → (dl-remix) → View → (Copycat) → Copy
	   prompt → Magic edit → Upscale → Make video → (Extend video) → Use as
	   mocap → Publish. Trailing ones drop off first as the card shrinks. */
	@container hoverbtns (max-width: 340px) {
		/* 9 buttons = 2 rows (5+4) need ~330px */
		.div_output_image_buttons > div:nth-child(n+10 of :not(.action-google-lens):not(.action-relight):not(.action-add-grain):not(.action-make-3d-model)) { display: none; }
	}
	@container hoverbtns (max-width: 260px) {
		/* 8 buttons = 2 rows of 4 need ~264px */
		.div_output_image_buttons > div:nth-child(n+9 of :not(.action-google-lens):not(.action-relight):not(.action-add-grain):not(.action-make-3d-model)) { display: none; }
	}
	@container hoverbtns (max-width: 220px) {
		/* 6 buttons = 2 rows of 3 need ~198px */
		.div_output_image_buttons > div:nth-child(n+7 of :not(.action-google-lens):not(.action-relight):not(.action-add-grain):not(.action-make-3d-model)) { display: none; }
	}
	@container hoverbtns (max-width: 160px) {
		/* 4 buttons = 2 rows of 2 need ~132px */
		.div_output_image_buttons > div:nth-child(n+5 of :not(.action-google-lens):not(.action-relight):not(.action-add-grain):not(.action-make-3d-model)) { display: none; }
	}
	@container hoverbtns (max-width: 110px) {
		.div_output_image_buttons > div:nth-child(n+3 of :not(.action-google-lens):not(.action-relight):not(.action-add-grain):not(.action-make-3d-model)) { display: none; }
	}

<script>
	
	
	// Global variable to store ElevenLabs voices
	var elevenLabsVoices = [];

	$(function() {

		// Load ElevenLabs voices on page load
		$.ajax({
			url: '/assets/tmp/elevenlabs_voices.json?' + Date.now(),
			dataType: 'json',
			success: function(data) {
				// Handle new wrapper format with 'voices' array
				elevenLabsVoices = data.voices || data;
				console.log('Loaded ' + elevenLabsVoices.length + ' ElevenLabs voices');
				// Initialize mocap voice selector from cookie after voices are loaded
				initMocapVoiceFromCookie();
			},
			error: function() {
				console.error('Error fetching ElevenLabs voices');
			}
		});

		$('.faq h4').bind('click',function() {
			$(this).toggleClass('expanded');
			$(this).next('div.answer').toggleClass('expanded');
		});
		
		var heroHeight=$('.hero').height();
		$(window).scroll(function() {
			$('.tooltip-ui').hide();
			if($(window).scrollTop()>heroHeight) {
				if(!$('.cta-box').hasClass('floating')) {
					$('.cta-box').addClass('floating');
				}
			} else {
				if($('.cta-box').hasClass('floating')) {
					$('.cta-box').removeClass('floating');
				}
			}
		});
		$('.tooltip').mouseenter(function() {

			if(isMobile) {
				return;
			}

			var $tooltip = $('.tooltip-ui');
			var rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
			var leftPx = rect.left;
			var topPx;

			// Get tooltip content
			var tooltipUiText = $(this).data('tooltip');
			tooltipUiText = str_replace('*linebreak*', '<br/>', tooltipUiText);
			var tooltipImage = $(this).data('tooltip-image');

			// Inject content
			if (tooltipImage) {
				$tooltip.find('img')
					.attr('src', 'https://resizeapi.com/resize-cgi/image/format=jpeg,width=800,quality=75/' + tooltipImage)
					.show();
			} else {
				$tooltip.find('img').hide();
			}

			$tooltip.find('span').html(tooltipUiText);

			// Wait for DOM to update so dimensions are correct
			$tooltip.css({ visibility: 'hidden', display: 'block' }); // temporarily show to get size
			var tooltipWidth = $tooltip.outerWidth();
			var tooltipHeight = $tooltip.outerHeight();
			$tooltip.css({ visibility: '', display: 'none' }); // hide again until ready

			const margin = 4;

			// Prefer below the element
			topPx = rect.bottom + margin;

			// If not enough space below, show above
			if ((rect.bottom + tooltipHeight + margin) > window.innerHeight) {
				topPx = rect.top - tooltipHeight - margin;
			}

			// Horizontal adjustment
			if ((leftPx + tooltipWidth) > window.innerWidth) {
				leftPx = window.innerWidth - tooltipWidth - margin;
			}
			if (leftPx < margin) {
				leftPx = margin;
			}

			$tooltip.css({
				left: leftPx + 'px',
				top: topPx + 'px'
			});

			console.log('checkIfOutsideWindowBoxX=' + (leftPx + tooltipWidth));
			console.log('$(window).width()=' + $(window).width());

			$tooltip.show();
		});

		$('.tooltip').mouseleave(function() {
			$('.tooltip-ui').hide();
		});
	})

	// Initialize mocap voice selector from cookie (defined here so it's available when AJAX loads voices)
	function initMocapVoiceFromCookie() {
		if (!elevenLabsVoices || elevenLabsVoices.length === 0) return;

		var cookieVoiceId = getCookie('last_voice_id');
		if (cookieVoiceId) {
			for (var i = 0; i < elevenLabsVoices.length; i++) {
				if (elevenLabsVoices[i].id === cookieVoiceId) {
					var voice = elevenLabsVoices[i];
					$('.mocap_voice_selector').data('selected-voice', voice.id);

					var displayName = '';
					if (voice.language_emoji) displayName += voice.language_emoji + ' ';
					if (voice.emoji) displayName += voice.emoji + ' ';
					displayName += voice.name;

					$('.mocap_selected_voice').text(displayName);
					$('.mocap_voice_selector').addClass('selected');
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	function explode(delimiter, string, limit) {
		
		if (arguments.length < 2 || typeof delimiter === 'undefined' || typeof string === 'undefined') return null;
		if (delimiter === '' || delimiter === false || delimiter === null) return false;
		if (typeof delimiter === 'function' || typeof delimiter === 'object' || typeof string === 'function' || typeof string ===
		'object') {
		return {
			0: ''
		};
		}
		if (delimiter === true) delimiter = '1';

		// Here we go...
		delimiter += '';
		string += '';

		var s = string.split(delimiter);

		if (typeof limit === 'undefined') return s;

		// Support for limit
		if (limit === 0) limit = 1;

		// Positive limit
		if (limit > 0) {
		if (limit >= s.length) return s;
		return s.slice(0, limit - 1)
			.concat([s.slice(limit - 1)
			.join(delimiter)
			]);
		}

		// Negative limit
		if (-limit >= s.length) return [];

		s.splice(s.length + limit);
		return s;
	}

			// wrap the landing showcase cards into explicit vertical columns so every other

			// examples folder keeps its normal grid.
			function buildLandingMasonry() {
				if(!document.documentElement.classList.contains('guest') && !document.documentElement.classList.contains('template')) return;
				var $landingGallery=$('.div_output_images.examples').first();
				if(!$landingGallery.length) return;
				var landingCards=$landingGallery.find('.div_output_image').toArray();
				if(!landingCards.length) return;
				var w=$(window).width();
				var cols=(w<=700) ? 2 : (w<=1100 ? 3 : 5);
				if($landingGallery.data('masonry-cols')==cols) return;
				$landingGallery.data('masonry-cols',cols);
				var masonryColumns=[];
				for(var i=0;i<cols;i++) masonryColumns.push($('<div class="landing_masonry_column"></div>')[0]);
				landingCards.forEach(function(card,idx){ masonryColumns[idx%cols].appendChild(card); });
				$landingGallery.empty().append(masonryColumns).addClass('masonry');
			}
			buildLandingMasonry();
			var landingMasonryResizeTimer=null;
			$(window).on('resize',function(){
				clearTimeout(landingMasonryResizeTimer);
				landingMasonryResizeTimer=setTimeout(buildLandingMasonry,200);

		$('body').on('click','.action-grab-video-frame',function(event){
			event.stopPropagation();
			
			// store whether video was playing before pausing
			var video = $('.image_viewer video').get(0);
			var wasPlaying = !video.paused && !video.ended && video.currentTime > 0 && video.readyState > 2;
			
			// first pause video
			video.pause();
			flash();
			bigFlash();

			// get the prompt so we can save it with the frame grab
			var manualPrompt=$('.photo-'+currentPhotoId).data('manual-prompt');
			
			// also check for data-description
			var description = $('.photo-'+currentPhotoId).data('description');
			if(description) {
				manualPrompt = description;
			}

			// check if this is a 3D model viewer
			if($('.image_viewer').hasClass('three_d')) {
				console.log('3D model capture detected');
				// handle 3D model capture
				var modelViewer = $('.image_viewer model-viewer')[0];
				if(modelViewer) {
					console.log('Model viewer found, capturing screenshot...');
					// Capture screenshot from model-viewer using correct API
					modelViewer.toBlob({
						mimeType: 'image/png',
						qualityArgument: 0.92,
						idealAspect: false
					}).then(function(blob) {
						console.log('3D model screenshot captured, blob size:', blob.size);
						// Create a File object from the blob
						var file = new File([blob], 'frame-grab-' + 1787396773 + '.png', { type: 'image/png' });
						console.log('Created file object:', file.name);
						
						// submit the model's photo_id to the upload to so we can attach the data to the new grab frame
						var photoId=currentPhotoId;
						
						// Upload the screenshot using existing uploadImportImage function
						uploadImportImage(file,true,photoId);
						console.log('3D model screenshot upload initiated');
					}).catch(function(error) {
						console.error('Error capturing 3D model screenshot:', error);
					});
				} else {
					console.log('No model-viewer element found');
				}
			} else {
				console.log('Video capture detected');
				// grab frame from video
				// Create a canvas element to capture the video frame
				var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
				var video = $(this).parent().find('video')[0];
				
				// Set canvas dimensions to match video
				canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
				canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
				
				// Draw current video frame to canvas
				var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
				ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

				// submit the video's photo_id to the upload to so we can attach the data to the new grab frame
				var photoId=currentPhotoId;
				

				// Convert canvas to blob and upload via uploadImportImage
				canvas.toBlob(function(blob) {
					// Create a File object from the blob
					var file = new File([blob], 'frame-grab-' + 1787396773 + '.png', { type: 'image/png' });
					
					// Upload the frame grab using existing uploadImportImage function
					uploadImportImage(file,true,photoId);
				}, 'image/png');

				// only continue playing if video was playing before the frame grab
				if(wasPlaying) {
					$('.image_viewer video').get(0).play();
				}

			}

			
		});

			// <reference photo + voice sample uploads>
			var videoReferenceImageUrl='';
			// multiple reference photos. videoReferenceImageUrl is kept in sync with the first
			// entry so any older code still reading the single var keeps working.
			var videoReferenceImageUrls=[];
			var maxVideoReferenceImages=5;
			var blankVideoReferenceSrc='data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==';

			// add an already-hosted r2 url straight to the list - used by the gallery drag,
			// which needs no upload because the file is already on our bucket
			function addVideoReferenceUrl(url) {
				if(!url) return false;
				if(videoReferenceImageUrls.indexOf(url)!==-1) return true;
				if(videoReferenceImageUrls.length>=maxVideoReferenceImages) {
					alert('You can use up to '+maxVideoReferenceImages+' reference photos.');
					return false;
				}
				videoReferenceImageUrls.push(url);
				renderVideoReferences();
				return true;
			}

			function renderVideoReferences() {
				var $box=$('.div_video_reference_uploader');
				var $container=$box.find('.multi_video_reference_container');
				videoReferenceImageUrl=videoReferenceImageUrls[0]||'';
				$container.empty();
				if(!videoReferenceImageUrls.length) {
					$box.removeClass('active multi_video_reference').addClass('collapsed');
					$('.img_video_reference').attr('src',blankVideoReferenceSrc);
					$('.div_video_reference_uploader_center').show();
					return;
				}
				$box.addClass('active multi_video_reference').removeClass('collapsed');
				$('.div_video_reference_uploader_center').hide();
				videoReferenceImageUrls.forEach(function(url,i){
					$container.append(
						'<span class="video_reference_thumb"><img src="'+url+'">'+
						'<span class="video_reference_thumb_remove" data-index="'+i+'" title="Remove">×</span></span>'
					);
				});
				if(videoReferenceImageUrls.length<maxVideoReferenceImages) {
					$container.append('<span class="video_reference_add" title="Add another reference photo">+</span>');
				}
			}
			var videoReferenceAudioUrl='';

			function uploadVideoReference(file, type, done) {
				var fd=new FormData();
				fd.append('file',file);
				fd.append('type',type);
				$.ajax({
					url:'/?action=upload-video-reference',
					type:'POST',
					data:fd,
					processData:false,
					contentType:false,
					dataType:'json'
				}).done(function(r){ done(r); }).fail(function(){ done(null); });
			}

			function handleVideoReferenceFile(file) {
				if(!file) return;
				// HEIC -> JPEG first (iPhone photos), then re-enter with the JPEG
				if(window.isHeicFile && window.isHeicFile(file)) {
					$('.div_video_reference_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
					window.heicToJpeg(file).then(function(jpeg){ handleVideoReferenceFile(jpeg); }).catch(function(){
						$('.div_video_reference_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
						alert('Sorry, we could not read that HEIC photo. Please export it as JPG and try again.');
					});
					return;
				}
				$('.div_video_reference_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
				uploadVideoReference(file,'image',function(r) {
					$('.div_video_reference_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
					if(!r || !r.success) {
						alert((r && r.message) ? r.message : 'Upload failed, try again');
						return;
					}
					// APPEND — picking another photo used to replace the current one, which made
					// it impossible to build up a set. The + tile / picker now adds to the list.
					if(videoReferenceImageUrls.indexOf(r.url)===-1) {
						if(videoReferenceImageUrls.length>=maxVideoReferenceImages) {
							alert('You can use up to '+maxVideoReferenceImages+' reference photos.');
							return;
						}
						videoReferenceImageUrls.push(r.url);
					}
					renderVideoReferences();
				});
			}
			// expose to window so the global paste/drop handlers (a different closure) can
			// route a pasted/dropped image into the video reference when the Make Video tab is open
			window.handleVideoReferenceFile = handleVideoReferenceFile;
			function handleVideoVoiceFile(file) {
				if(!file) return;

				$('.div_video_voice_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
				uploadVideoReference(file,'audio',function(r) {
					$('.div_video_voice_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
					if(!r || !r.success) {
						alert((r && r.message) ? r.message : 'Upload failed, try again');

				});
			}

			// re-fill the reference photo + voice boxes from a previous video's saved urls
			// (used by copy prompt / make another video). No re-upload: the urls are already
			// our validated R2 uploads, so we set them straight into the box state
			function restoreVideoReferences(imageUrl, audioUrl) {
				if(imageUrl) {
					// older videos stored ONE url; newer ones store an array
					videoReferenceImageUrls=(Array.isArray(imageUrl)?imageUrl:[imageUrl])
						.filter(function(u){ return !!u; })
						.slice(0,maxVideoReferenceImages);
					renderVideoReferences();

				if(audioUrl) {

			$('body').on('drop','.div_video_reference_uploader',function(event) {
				event.preventDefault();
				event.stopPropagation();
				$(this).removeClass('drag-over');
				var dt=event.originalEvent.dataTransfer;
				// an OS file drag
				if(dt && dt.files && dt.files[0]) { handleVideoReferenceFile(dt.files[0]); return; }

				// an internal drag from the gallery: there's no OS file, just the
				// {photo_id,url} payload the card's dragstart stashed. Re-upload it through
				// the normal reference endpoint rather than passing the gallery url straight
				// through - make-video only accepts urls beginning
				// https://r2-us-west.photoai.com/video-reference-, so a raw gallery url would
				// be silently dropped server-side and the user would see it vanish on submit.
				var droppedPhoto = window.getDroppedGalleryPhoto ? window.getDroppedGalleryPhoto(event) : null;
				if(droppedPhoto && droppedPhoto.url) {
					// already on our r2 bucket, so reuse it in place - no fetch, no re-upload,
					// no duplicate object. make-video accepts any r2-us-west.photoai.com url.
					if(droppedPhoto.url.indexOf('https://r2-us-west.photoai.com/')===0) {
						addVideoReferenceUrl(droppedPhoto.url);
					}
					else if(window.fetchUrlAsFile) {
						// anything not on our bucket (shouldn't normally happen) still goes
						// through the upload path so it ends up somewhere make-video accepts
						$('.div_video_reference_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
						window.fetchUrlAsFile(droppedPhoto.url, function(galleryFile) {
							if(!galleryFile) {
								$('.div_video_reference_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
								alert('Could not use that photo as a reference, try uploading it instead');
								return;
							}
							handleVideoReferenceFile(galleryFile);
						});
					}
				}
			});

				event.stopPropagation();

			// Seedance render time is CONSTANT regardless of clip length (a 15s and a

			function updateMakeVideoButtonTime() {

			// Video credits are only deducted server-side when the video FINISHES (~minutes
			// later via the webhook), so making several at once showed a stale balance ("600
			// credits" while 6 videos run). Subtract the cost from the DISPLAY the moment a
			// video is queued, remember what we charged per photo_id, then: on finish, don't
			// double-charge (the server already deducted); on fail/nsfw, refund the display.
			window.optimisticCredits = window.optimisticCredits || {}; // photo_id -> {main, extra}
			window.setCreditDisplayValues = function(main, extra) {
				main = Math.max(0, parseInt(main,10)||0);
				extra = Math.max(0, parseInt(extra,10)||0);
				$('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits',main).text(number_format(main)).addClass('glow');
				$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits',extra).text(number_format(extra));
				setTimeout(function(){ $('.photoCreditsLeft,.photoCreditsExtraLeft').removeClass('glow'); }, 1000);
			};
			window.reserveCreditsForVideo = function(photoId, cost) {
				cost = parseInt(cost,10)||0;
				if(!photoId || cost<=0 || window.optimisticCredits[photoId]) return;
				var main = parseInt($('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits'),10)||0;
				var extra = parseInt($('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits'),10)||0;
				var fromMain = Math.min(main, cost);
				var fromExtra = cost - fromMain;
				window.optimisticCredits[photoId] = {main:fromMain, extra:fromExtra};
				window.setCreditDisplayValues(main - fromMain, extra - fromExtra);
			};
			// call on finish: server already deducted, so just stop tracking (no re-charge).
			// returns true if this id was optimistically reserved (so the finish handler skips
			// its own decrement and doesn't double-charge).
			window.settleReservedCredits = function(photoId) {
				if(!window.optimisticCredits[photoId]) return false;
				delete window.optimisticCredits[photoId];
				return true;
			};
			// call on fail/nsfw: add the reserved amount back to the display
			window.refundReservedCredits = function(photoId) {
				var c = window.optimisticCredits[photoId];
				if(!c) return false;
				delete window.optimisticCredits[photoId];
				var main = (parseInt($('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits'),10)||0) + c.main;
				var extra = (parseInt($('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits'),10)||0) + c.extra;
				window.setCreditDisplayValues(main, extra);
				return true;
			};

				var moods = new Set();

				$.each(elevenLabsVoices, function(index, voice) {

					// Handle single language only
					if (voice.language) {
						// Store language with its emoji (if not already stored)
						if (!languagesMap[voice.language]) {
							languagesMap[voice.language] = voice.language_emoji || '';

					if (voice.mood) moods.add(voice.mood);
					if (voice.age) ages.add(voice.age);

			// Global variable to track if we're processing chunks to prevent recursion
			var processingChunks = false;
			var scriptChunksQueue = [];
			
			function splitScriptIntoChunks(script) {
				var chunks = [];
				
				if (script.length <= 350) {
					chunks.push(script);
					return chunks;
				}
				
				// First, try to split by sentences (if punctuation exists)
				var sentences = script.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+/g);
				
				if (sentences && sentences.length > 1) {
					// Script has punctuation, try smart sentence-based splitting
					console.log('Detected punctuation, attempting smart sentence splitting...');
					
					var currentChunk = '';
					var currentLength = 0;
					
					for (var i = 0; i < sentences.length; i++) {
						var sentence = sentences[i].trim();
						var sentenceLength = sentence.length;
						
						// If this single sentence is over 300 chars, we need to split it by words
						if (sentenceLength > 300) {
							// Add current chunk if it exists
							if (currentChunk !== '') {
								chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
								currentChunk = '';
								currentLength = 0;
							}
							
							// Split this long sentence by words
							var words = sentence.split(' ');
							var wordChunk = '';
							var wordChunkLength = 0;
							
							for (var j = 0; j < words.length; j++) {
								var word = words[j];
								var wordLength = word.length + (wordChunk === '' ? 0 : 1);
								
								if (wordChunkLength + wordLength > 300) {
									if (wordChunk !== '') {
										chunks.push(wordChunk.trim());
										wordChunk = word;
										wordChunkLength = word.length;
									}
								} else {
									wordChunk += (wordChunk === '' ? '' : ' ') + word;
									wordChunkLength += wordLength;
								}
							}
							
							if (wordChunk !== '') {
								chunks.push(wordChunk.trim());
							}
						}
						// If adding this sentence would exceed 300 chars, start a new chunk
						else if (currentLength + sentenceLength + (currentChunk === '' ? 0 : 1) > 300) {
							if (currentChunk !== '') {
								chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
							}
							currentChunk = sentence;
							currentLength = sentenceLength;
						}
						// Otherwise add sentence to current chunk
						else {
							currentChunk += (currentChunk === '' ? '' : ' ') + sentence;
							currentLength += sentenceLength + (currentChunk === '' ? 0 : 1);
						}
					}
					
					// Add the last chunk if not empty
					if (currentChunk !== '') {
						chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
					}
					
					// Check if there's text after the last punctuation mark
					var lastPunctuationIndex = Math.max(
						script.lastIndexOf('.'),
						script.lastIndexOf('!'),
						script.lastIndexOf('?')
					);
					
					if (lastPunctuationIndex !== -1 && lastPunctuationIndex < script.length - 1) {
						var remainingText = script.substring(lastPunctuationIndex + 1).trim();
						if (remainingText) {
							// Check if we can append to last chunk or need new one
							var lastChunk = chunks[chunks.length - 1];
							if (lastChunk && (lastChunk.length + remainingText.length + 1) <= 300) {
								chunks[chunks.length - 1] = lastChunk + ' ' + remainingText;
							} else {
								chunks.push(remainingText);
							}
						}
					}
				} else {
					// No punctuation detected, fall back to word-based splitting
					console.log('No punctuation detected, using word-based splitting...');
					
					var words = script.split(' ');
					var currentChunk = '';
					var currentLength = 0;
					
					for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
						var word = words[i];
						var wordLength = word.length + 1; // +1 for space
						
						// If adding this word would exceed 300 chars
						if (currentLength + wordLength > 300) {
							if (currentChunk !== '') {
								chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
								currentChunk = word;
								currentLength = word.length;
							}
						} else {
							currentChunk += (currentChunk === '' ? '' : ' ') + word;
							currentLength += wordLength;
						}
					}
					
					// Add the last chunk if not empty
					if (currentChunk !== '') {
						chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
					}
				}
				
				return chunks;
			}
			
			function processNextChunk() {
				if (scriptChunksQueue.length === 0) {
					processingChunks = false;
					return;
				}

				var chunkData = scriptChunksQueue.shift();
				var chunkScript = chunkData.script;
				var selectedVoice = chunkData.voice;
				var photoUrl = chunkData.photoUrl;
				var photoId = chunkData.photoId;
				var addCaptions = chunkData.addCaptions;
				var uploadedAudioUrl = chunkData.uploadedAudioUrl || '';
				var chunkIndex = chunkData.chunkIndex;
				var totalChunks = chunkData.totalChunks;

				console.log('Processing chunk ' + (chunkIndex + 1) + ' of ' + totalChunks + ': ' + (uploadedAudioUrl ? '[uploaded audio]' : chunkScript.substring(0, 50) + '...'));

				// Update the textarea to show current chunk being processed
				$('.talking_video_modal_script_textarea').val(chunkScript);
				updateTalkingVideoCharCount();

				// Submit this chunk
				submitTalkingVideoChunk(chunkScript, selectedVoice, photoUrl, photoId, addCaptions, uploadedAudioUrl, function() {
					// After successful submission, process next chunk with a small delay
					setTimeout(function() {
						processNextChunk();
					}, 1000);
				});
			}

			function updateTalkingVideoCharCount() {
				var currentLength = $('.talking_video_modal_script_textarea').val().length;
				var maxLength = $('.talking_video_modal_script_textarea').attr('maxlength')
				var uploadedAudioUrl = $('.talking_video_modal').data('uploaded-audio-url');
				var costInCredits;

				if (uploadedAudioUrl) {
					// Flat rate for uploaded audio (no ElevenLabs cost)
					costInCredits = 5;
				} else {
					// add cost in credits too with $config['talkingVideoPerCharacterInPhotoCreditsEquivalent']
					costInCredits = Math.ceil(currentLength * 0.033333333333333);
				}

				// If source is an image (not video), add video creation cost
				var isVideo = $('.talking_video_modal').data('is-video');
				if (!isVideo) {
					costInCredits += 100;
				}

				if (uploadedAudioUrl) {
					$('.talking_video_modal_char_count').text('Audio uploaded (cost: ' + costInCredits + ' credits)');
				} else {
					$('.talking_video_modal_char_count').text(currentLength + '/' + maxLength + ' (cost: ' + costInCredits + ' credits)');
				}

			// Cookie helper functions
			function setCookie(name, value, days) {
				var expires = "";
				if (days) {
					var date = new Date();
					date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
					expires = "; expires=" + date.toUTCString();
				}
				document.cookie = name + "=" + (value || "") + expires + "; path=/";
			}
			
			function getCookie(name) {
				var nameEQ = name + "=";
				var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
				for(var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
					var c = ca[i];
					while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
					if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) == 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
				}
				return null;
			}

					// user's remembered mute choice, so muting one video keeps the next muted too
					var userMutedVideos = false;
					try { userMutedVideos = sessionStorage.getItem('video_user_muted') === '1'; } catch(e){}
					var muteChangeIsProgrammatic = false;
					var videoEl = $('.image_viewer video').get(0);
					function programmaticMute(m) {
						if(videoEl.muted === m) return; // no change => no volumechange event to swallow
						muteChangeIsProgrammatic = true;
						videoEl.muted = m;
					}
					// persist ONLY user-initiated mute toggles (from the native video controls)
					videoEl.onvolumechange = function() {
						if(muteChangeIsProgrammatic) { muteChangeIsProgrammatic = false; return; }
						userMutedVideos = videoEl.muted;
						try { sessionStorage.setItem('video_user_muted', videoEl.muted ? '1' : '0'); } catch(e){}
					};
					programmaticMute(true);

					// Restore the speed the user last picked, then auto-play
					// (browsers allow autoplay while muted; existing onloadeddata
					// will unmute videos that have an audio track).
					var savedRate = 1.0;
					try {
						var raw = sessionStorage.getItem('video_playback_rate');
						if(raw) {
							var parsed = parseFloat(raw);
							if(!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > 0) savedRate = parsed;
						}
					} catch(e){}

					videoEl.playbackRate = savedRate;

					// jump to the same play position as the video we navigated away from,
					// once metadata is loaded (seeking before that is ignored/throws in
					// Safari); skip if this take is shorter than the carried position.
					// While the seek is pending the video is kept invisible, so you don't
					// see a flash of frame 0 / the poster before the jump — revealed on
					// 'seeked', with a failsafe timer so it can never stay hidden.
					if(imageViewerRevealCleanup) imageViewerRevealCleanup();
					videoEl.style.opacity = '';
					if(carryVideoTime != null) {
						videoEl.style.opacity = '0';
						var revealVideo = function() {
							videoEl.style.opacity = '';
							if(imageViewerRevealCleanup) imageViewerRevealCleanup();
						};
						var revealTimer = setTimeout(revealVideo, 700);
						videoEl.addEventListener('seeked', revealVideo);
						imageViewerRevealCleanup = function() {
							clearTimeout(revealTimer);
							videoEl.removeEventListener('seeked', revealVideo);
							imageViewerRevealCleanup = null;
						};
					}
					videoEl.onloadedmetadata = (carryVideoTime != null) ? function() {
						if(videoEl.duration && carryVideoTime < videoEl.duration) {
							videoEl.currentTime = carryVideoTime;
						} else {
							videoEl.style.opacity = ''; // shorter take: plays from 0, nothing to wait for
						}
					} : null;

					// Sync the speed button label with the saved rate.
					if(savedRate !== 1.0) {
						var speedLabelMap = {0.25:'0.25x', 0.5:'0.5x', 1:'1x', 1.5:'1.5x', 2:'2x', 2.5:'2.5x'};
						var label = speedLabelMap[savedRate] || (savedRate + 'x');
						$('.action-play-slow-motion').text(label).addClass('active');
					} else {
						$('.action-play-slow-motion').text('1x').removeClass('active');
					}

					videoEl.onloadeddata = function() {
						var hasAudio = (videoEl.webkitAudioDecodedByteCount > 0 || (videoEl.audioTracks && videoEl.audioTracks.length > 0));
						// only auto-unmute a video with audio if the user hasn't chosen to mute;
						// if they muted a previous video, keep this one muted too
						if(userMutedVideos) {
							programmaticMute(true);
						} else if(hasAudio) {
							programmaticMute(false);
						}
						// Re-apply rate after the metadata loads (some browsers
						// reset playbackRate when src changes).
						videoEl.playbackRate = savedRate;
					};

					var playPromise = videoEl.play();
					if(playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
						playPromise.catch(function(){
							// Autoplay blocked (rare since we're muted) — leave it paused;
							// user can press space or the play button.
						});
					}

					$('.loading_spinner.main').hide();
				}
				else {
					// Load image
					$('.image_viewer > img:not(.swipe_preview)').show();
					$('.image_viewer video').hide();
					$('.image_viewer').removeClass('video');
					$('.image_viewer').removeClass('three_d');
					$('.image_viewer').addClass('photo');
					$('.make-video-label').text('Make video');

					if(!$('.image_viewer').hasClass('zoomed-in')) {

						$('.image_viewer > img:not(.swipe_preview)').css('background-image', 'url(' + gallerySrc + ')');
					}

					// Hide spinner once gallery-size image is showing
					$('.loading_spinner.main').hide();

					$('.image_viewer').data('original-src', originalSrc);

					// Check if image is already cached
					var testImg = new Image();
					testImg.src = originalSrc;
					var isCached = testImg.complete && testImg.naturalWidth > 0;

					// Load full resolution image
					$('.image_viewer > img:not(.swipe_preview)').unbind('load');
					$('.image_viewer > img:not(.swipe_preview)').on('load', function() {
						if($(this).attr('src') === originalSrc) {

							// Update mobile nav height to match image

							// Restore scroll position if zoomed in

's' : '') + ' ' + remixModelNames + ' using ' + aiModelLabel + '? This will create ' + remixCount + ' new photo' + (remixCount > 1 ? 's' : '') + '.')) {

					.then(blob => {

						var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

			var speedLabels = ['0.25x', '0.5x', '1x', '1.5x', '2x', '2.5x'];

			function changeSpeed($button, direction) {
				var $video = $('.image_viewer video')[0];
				if (!$video) return;

				var currentText = $button.text();
				var currentIndex = speedLabels.indexOf(currentText);
				if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 2; // default to 1x

				var nextIndex;
				if (direction === 'slower') {
					nextIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : speedLevels.length - 1;
				} else {
					nextIndex = currentIndex < speedLevels.length - 1 ? currentIndex + 1 : 0;
				}

				var nextSpeed = speedLevels[nextIndex];
				var nextText = speedLabels[nextIndex];

				$video.playbackRate = nextSpeed;
				$button.text(nextText);

				if (nextSpeed === 1.0) {
					$button.removeClass('active');
				} else {
					$button.addClass('active');
				}

				// Persist for this page session only (resets on reload / new tab).
				try { sessionStorage.setItem('video_playback_rate', String(nextSpeed)); } catch(e){}
			}

		// <drag and drop functionality>
			function setupDragAndDrop(uploaderSelector, inputSelector, uploadFunction) {
				$(uploaderSelector).on({
					'dragover': function(e) {
						e.preventDefault();
						e.stopPropagation();
						$(this).addClass('drag-over');
					},
					'dragenter': function(e) {
						e.preventDefault();
						e.stopPropagation();
						$(this).addClass('drag-over');
					},
					'dragleave': function(e) {
						e.preventDefault();
						e.stopPropagation();
						// Only remove drag-over if we're actually leaving the uploader area
						if (!$(this).has(e.relatedTarget).length && e.relatedTarget !== this) {
							$(this).removeClass('drag-over');
						}
					},
					'drop': function(e) {
						e.preventDefault();
						e.stopPropagation();
						$(this).removeClass('drag-over');

						var files = e.originalEvent.dataTransfer.files;

						// internal gallery-image drag (no OS file): Remix sets copycat directly (no
						// re-upload); clothing/product/import/mocap fetch the R2 image to a File.
						var galleryPhoto = getDroppedGalleryPhoto(e);
						if ((!files || files.length === 0) && galleryPhoto) {
							if (uploadFunction === 'copycat') {
								setCopycatFromGalleryPhoto(galleryPhoto);
							} else if (uploadFunction === 'import') {
								$('.div_import_uploader').addClass('active').removeClass('collapsed');
								$('.div_import_uploader_center').hide();
								$('.div_import_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
								fetchUrlAsFile(galleryPhoto.url, function(f){
									if(!f){ $('.div_import_uploader .loading_spinner').hide(); alert('Could not load that image'); return; }
									uploadImportImage(f, false, '', function(){ $('.div_import_uploader .loading_spinner').hide(); clearImportImage(); });
								});
							} else if (uploadFunction === 'clothing' || uploadFunction === 'product' || uploadFunction === 'mocap_person') {
								fetchUrlAsFile(galleryPhoto.url, function(f){
									if(!f){ alert('Could not load that image'); return; }
									if(uploadFunction === 'clothing') uploadClothingImage(f);
									else if(uploadFunction === 'product') uploadProductImage(f);
									else if(uploadFunction === 'mocap_person') uploadMocapPersonImage(f);
								});
							}
							return;
						}

						if (files.length > 0) {

							// Import supports batch upload of up to 15 images
							if (uploadFunction === 'import') {
								var maxFiles = 15;
								var totalFiles = Math.min(files.length, maxFiles);
								if (files.length > maxFiles) {
									alert('You can only import up to ' + maxFiles + ' photos at once. Only the first ' + maxFiles + ' will be imported.');
								}
								$('.div_import_uploader').addClass('active').removeClass('collapsed');
								$('.div_import_uploader_center').hide();
								$('.div_import_uploader .loading_spinner').show();

								var dragImportQueue = [];
								for (var i = 0; i < totalFiles; i++) {
									if (files[i].type.startsWith('image/')) dragImportQueue.push(files[i]);
								}
								if(dragImportQueue.length > 0) {
									// Show first photo preview
									var dragPreviewReader = new FileReader();
									dragPreviewReader.onload = function() {
										$('.div_import_uploader .img_import').attr('src', dragPreviewReader.result).css('opacity', 0.5);
									};
									dragPreviewReader.readAsDataURL(dragImportQueue[0]);
									$('.div_import_uploader .loading_message').text('1/' + dragImportQueue.length);

									var dragImportIndex = 0;
									function processDragImport() {
										if(dragImportIndex >= dragImportQueue.length) {
											$('.div_import_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
											clearImportImage();
											return;
										}
										var f = dragImportQueue[dragImportIndex];
										var dr = new FileReader();
										dr.onload = function() {
											$('.div_import_uploader .img_import').attr('src', dr.result).css('opacity', 0.5);
										};
										dr.readAsDataURL(f);
										$('.div_import_uploader .loading_message').text((dragImportIndex + 1) + '/' + dragImportQueue.length);
										uploadImportImage(f, false, '', function() {
											dragImportIndex++;
											processDragImport();
										});
									}
									processDragImport();
								}
							}
							// Other uploaders only support single file
							else {
								var file = files[0];

								// Check if it's an image
								if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
									if (uploadFunction === 'copycat') {
										uploadCopycatImage(file);
									} else if (uploadFunction === 'clothing') {
										uploadClothingImage(file);
									} else if (uploadFunction === 'product') {
										uploadProductImage(file);
									} else if (uploadFunction === 'mocap_person') {
										uploadMocapPersonImage(file);
									}
								}
								// Check if it's a video
								else if (file.type.startsWith('video/')) {
									if (uploadFunction === 'mocap_video') {
										uploadMocapVideo(file);
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				});
			}

			$(document).on('dragstart', '.div_output_image', function(e){

			window.getDroppedGalleryPhoto = function(e){ return getDroppedGalleryPhoto(e); };

				try{ var raw=e.originalEvent.dataTransfer.getData('application/x-photoai-photo'); if(raw) return JSON.parse(raw); }catch(_){}

		// shared: upload a file into the Faceswap box (used by the faceswap uploader, paste, and drop).
		// sets the shared copycat state at 0.95 (faceswap) strength and clears the Remix box.
		function uploadFaceswapFile(file){
			if(!file) return;
			 showStripeModal(); return; 			$('div.faceswap_mode .h3_input').addClass('expanded');
			$('div.faceswap_mode .expandable_div').addClass('expanded');
			if(window.syncFaceswapTabFlag) syncFaceswapTabFlag();
			var $fu = $('.div_faceswap_uploader');
			$fu.removeClass('collapsed').addClass('active');
			$fu.find('.div_faceswap_uploader_center').hide();
			$fu.find('.loading_spinner').show();
			var reader = new FileReader();
			reader.onload = function(){
				var dataURL = reader.result;
				$fu.find('.img_faceswap').attr('src', dataURL).css('opacity', 0.5);
				var fd = new FormData(); fd.append('file', file);
				var xhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
				xhttp.open('POST','/copycat_upload',true);
				xhttp.onreadystatechange = function(){
					if(this.readyState!=4) return;
					$fu.find('.loading_spinner').hide();
					if(this.status!=200){ alert('Upload failed, please try again'); return; }
					var reply; try{ reply=JSON.parse(xhttp.responseText); }catch(e){ alert('Upload failed'); return; }
					if(!reply.success){ alert(reply.message||'Upload failed'); return; }
					copycatId='upload-id-'+reply.copycat_id;
					copycatUrl=reply.copycat_url;
					$('.copycat_id').val(copycatUrl);
					$('.copycat_strength').val('0.95');
					// clear the Remix box (mutually exclusive)
					$('.div_copycat_uploader').removeClass('active multi_copycat').addClass('collapsed');
					$('.div_copycat_uploader .multi_copycat_container').html('');
					$('.div_copycat_uploader .img_copycat').attr('src','data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==');
					$('.div_copycat_uploader_center').show();
					$('.copycat_mode_current_copycat_thumbnail').attr('src','').hide();
					$fu.find('.img_faceswap').attr('src',dataURL).css('opacity',1);
					$('.faceswap_mode_current_thumbnail').attr('src',dataURL).css('display','inline-block');
					$('.action-take-photo').removeClass('disabled');
				};
				xhttp.send(fd);
			};
			reader.readAsDataURL(file);
		}

			//
			if(typeof templates[templateSlug]['prompts'][promptIterator]==='undefined') {
				// finished all prompts, end
				userHasBatchTemplateRunning=false;
				$('.div_template').removeClass('active');
				$('div.sidebar .manual_prompt').val('').removeClass('active');

				copycatId='';

					// human, not robot
					alert("Done with taking all photos for your photo pack! Now you can wait for them to process! Meanwhile you can start more photo packs or take photos yourself. You can close the tab and come back later as photos process in the background. Enjoy!");
				}
				else {
					// robot, reload page so we continue the robot cycle
					window.location.reload();

		$('.action-take-photo').removeClass('disabled');

		templateBatchPromptIterator++;

		// <do next prompt>
			setTimeout(function(){
				templateDoNextPrompt(templateSlug,templateBatchPromptIterator,event);
			},1000,templateSlug,event);

	// Helper: Load file as <img>
	function loadImageAsImg(file) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const reader = new FileReader();
			reader.onload = function(e) {
				const img = new Image();
				img.onload = () => resolve(img);
				img.onerror = reject;
				img.src = e.target.result;
			};
			reader.onerror = reject;
			reader.readAsDataURL(file);
		});
	}

	// <HEIC support> iPhone photos upload as HEIC, which browsers (except Safari)
	// can't decode into an <img>/<canvas>, so the server got raw HEIC and rejected it.
	// Convert HEIC -> JPEG in the browser (heic2any = libheif compiled to WASM),
	// lazy-loaded only when a HEIC is actually picked, then re-enter the normal flow.
	window.isHeicFile = function(file){
		if(!file) return false;
		var t=(file.type||'').toLowerCase();
		if(t.indexOf('heic')>=0 || t.indexOf('heif')>=0) return true;
		return /\.(heic|heif)$/i.test(file.name||'');
	};
	window._heicLibPromise = null;
	window.loadHeicLib = function(){
		if(window.heic2any) return Promise.resolve();
		if(window._heicLibPromise) return window._heicLibPromise;
		window._heicLibPromise = new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
			var s=document.createElement('script');
			s.src='/assets/heic2any.min.js'; // self-hosted (heic2any 0.0.4 = libheif WASM)
			s.onload=resolve;
			s.onerror=function(){ window._heicLibPromise=null; reject(new Error('heic2any load failed')); };
			document.head.appendChild(s);
		});
		return window._heicLibPromise;
	};
	window.heicToJpeg = function(file){
		return window.loadHeicLib().then(function(){
			return heic2any({blob:file, toType:'image/jpeg', quality:0.92});
		}).then(function(res){
			var blob = Array.isArray(res) ? res[0] : res;
			var base = (file.name||'photo').replace(/\.(heic|heif)$/i,'');
			return new File([blob], base+'.jpg', {type:'image/jpeg'});
		});
	};
	// </HEIC support>

	function uploadMocapVideo(file) {
		$('.div_mocap_video_uploader').removeClass('collapsed');
		$('.div_mocap_video_uploader').addClass('active');
		$('.div_mocap_video_uploader_center').hide();
		$('.div_mocap_video_uploader .loading_spinner').show();

		// Check video duration and generate thumbnail before uploading
		var maxDuration = 30;
		var checkVideo = document.createElement('video');
		checkVideo.preload = 'auto';
		checkVideo.muted = true;
		checkVideo.playsInline = true;

		checkVideo.onloadeddata = function() {
			// Check duration
			if (checkVideo.duration > maxDuration) {
				URL.revokeObjectURL(checkVideo.src);
				$('.div_mocap_video_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
				alert('Video is too long (' + Math.round(checkVideo.duration) + 's). Maximum duration is ' + maxDuration + ' seconds.');
				$('.action-delete-mocap-video').click();
				return;
			}

			// Seek to 0.1s to get a real frame (first frame can be blank)
			checkVideo.currentTime = 0.1;
		};

		checkVideo.onseeked = function() {
			// Generate thumbnail
			var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
			canvas.width = checkVideo.videoWidth;
			canvas.height = checkVideo.videoHeight;
			canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(checkVideo, 0, 0);
			var thumbnailUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
			$('.div_mocap_video_uploader .img_mocap_video').attr('src', thumbnailUrl).css('opacity', 1);
			$('.mocap_mode_current_video_thumbnail').attr('src', thumbnailUrl).css('display', 'inline-block');

			// Store video dimensions for orientation
			mocapVideoWidth = checkVideo.videoWidth;
			mocapVideoHeight = checkVideo.videoHeight;

			URL.revokeObjectURL(checkVideo.src);

			// Ask BEFORE starting the upload so users on slow connections don't
			// miss the popup while waiting for the upload to finish. Capture the
			// answer + model + canvas now; replay the first-frame photo flow
			// once the video upload completes.
			var firstFrameModelAtPrompt = selectedModelIds[0];
			var firstFrameCanvas = canvas;
			var wantsFirstFramePhoto = false;
			if(firstFrameModelAtPrompt && !mocapPersonPhotoDismissed && !mocapPersonUrl) {
				if(confirm("Do you want to generate a photo with your model matching the first frame for the mocap video?\n\nThis will be the photo that Mocap uses to replace the character with. It helps if it's similar to the first frame which is why we can generate it for you!")) {
					wantsFirstFramePhoto = true;
					// Show the generating state immediately so the user has feedback
					// while the video upload is still in flight.
					$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
					$('.div_mocap_person_uploader').removeClass('collapsed').addClass('active');
					$('.div_mocap_person_uploader_center').hide();
				} else {
					mocapPersonPhotoDismissed=true;
				}
			}

			// Duration OK, proceed with upload
			var uploadUrl='/mocap_video_upload';

			var formData = new FormData();
			formData.append('file', file);

			var xhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
			xhttp.open('POST', uploadUrl, true);

			xhttp.onreadystatechange = function() {
				if (this.readyState == 4 && this.status == 200) {
					$('.div_mocap_video_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();

					var reply=JSON.parse(xhttp.responseText);
					console.log(reply);

					if(!reply.success) {
						alert(reply.message);
						$('.action-delete-mocap-video').click();
						return;
					}

					mocapVideoUrl=reply.copycat_url;

					$('.action-take-photo').removeClass('disabled');
					$('.div_mocap_video_uploader').removeClass('collapsed');
					$('.div_mocap_video_uploader').addClass('active');
					$('.div_mocap_video_uploader_center').hide();

					// Auto-generate person photo from first frame, replaying
					// the answer the user gave before the upload started.
					var canvas = firstFrameCanvas;
					var selectedModel = firstFrameModelAtPrompt;
					if(selectedModel && wantsFirstFramePhoto) {
						canvas.toBlob(function(blob) {
							var formData2 = new FormData();
							formData2.append('file', blob, 'mocap-frame.png');
							$.ajax({
								url: '/copycat_upload',
								type: 'POST',
								dataType: 'json',
								data: formData2,
								processData: false,
								contentType: false
							}).done(function(uploadReply) {
								if(uploadReply && uploadReply.copycat_url) {
									// Auto-detect the prompt from the actual first frame before
									// queuing the take-photo. Without this, take-photo defaults to
									// "model wearing casual outfit on street" → auto-improved into
									// the same cached generic urban-casual prompt for every user
									// (denim jacket, white tee, cobblestone, golden hour). With it,
									// the model gets generated matching the real first frame.
									function fireMocapTakePhoto(detectedPrompt) {
										var takePhotoData = {
											mode: 'copycat',
											copycat_id: uploadReply.copycat_url,
											copycat_url: uploadReply.copycat_url,
											copycat_strength: 0.75,
											copycat_what: 'full',
											model_id: selectedModel,
											amount_of_photos: 1,
											orientation: (mocapVideoWidth > mocapVideoHeight) ? 'landscape' : 'portrait',
											realism: 1
										};
										if(detectedPrompt) {
											takePhotoData.manual_prompt = detectedPrompt;
											// Detected prompt already describes the scene we want;
											// don't let the auto-improver rewrite it.
											takePhotoData.auto_improve_prompt = 0;
										}
										$.ajax({
											url: '/?action=take-photo',
											dataType: 'json',
											data: takePhotoData,
											type: 'POST'
										}).done(function(takeReply) {
											if(takeReply.success && takeReply.photos && takeReply.photos[0]) {
												var photo = takeReply.photos[0];
												photo['status'] = 'processing';
												// Add to gallery with placeholder + poller
												var html = makePhotoBox(photo);
												$('.div_output_images.camera').prepend(html);
												loadingSpinnerStep(photo['photo_id']);
												setTimeout(waitForServerToGenerate, (pollIntervalTime*2*Math.random()), photo['photo_id'], 'poll_for_preprocessed');
												$('.placeholder .loading_spinner').show();
												// Also poll to set as mocap person when done
												waitForMocapPersonPhoto(photo['photo_id']);
											} else {
												$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
											}
										}).fail(function() {
											$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
										});
									}

									$.ajax({
										url: '/auto_detect_prompt?copycat_url=' + encodeURIComponent(uploadReply.copycat_url),
										dataType: 'json',
										timeout: 45000
									}).done(function(desc) {
										fireMocapTakePhoto(desc && desc.success && desc.prompt ? String(desc.prompt) : '');
									}).fail(function() {
										// On detect failure, still queue the photo — just without
										// a prompt, falling back to the old behavior rather than
										// breaking the whole mocap flow.
										fireMocapTakePhoto('');
									});
								} else {
									$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
								}
							}).fail(function() {
								$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
							});

				} else if (this.readyState == 4) {

					$('.div_mocap_video_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
					alert('Upload failed. Please try again.');
					$('.action-delete-mocap-video').click();

	var mocapPersonPhotoStartTime = null;
	var mocapPersonPhotoTimer = null;
	function updateMocapPersonTimer() {
		if(!mocapPersonPhotoStartTime) return;
		var elapsed = (Date.now() - mocapPersonPhotoStartTime) / 1000;
		if(elapsed > 60) {
			var m = Math.floor(elapsed / 60);
			var s = elapsed - m * 60;
			var text = m + 'm' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s.toFixed(0) + 's';
		} else {
			var text = elapsed.toFixed(1) + 's';
		}
		$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_message').text(text).show();
		mocapPersonPhotoTimer = setTimeout(updateMocapPersonTimer, 100);
	}
	function waitForMocapPersonPhoto(photoId) {
		if(!mocapPersonPhotoStartTime) {
			mocapPersonPhotoStartTime = Date.now();
			updateMocapPersonTimer();
		}
		var time = new Date().getTime();
		$.ajax({
			url: '/assets/tmp/'+photoId+'-pre.json?'+time,
			type: 'GET',
			timeout: 5000
		}).done(function(photo) {
			if(photo && photo['status']=='finished' && photo['photo_url']) {
				mocapPersonUrl = photo['photo_url'];
				clearTimeout(mocapPersonPhotoTimer);
				mocapPersonPhotoStartTime = null;
				$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
				$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .loading_message').hide();
				$('.div_mocap_person_uploader .img_mocap_person').attr('src', photo['photo_url']);
				$('.mocap_mode_current_person_thumbnail').attr('src', photo['photo_url']).css('display','inline-block');
			} else {
				setTimeout(function() { waitForMocapPersonPhoto(photoId); }, 3000);
			}
		}).fail(function() {
			setTimeout(function() { waitForMocapPersonPhoto(photoId); }, 3000);
		});
	}

	function forceDownload(blob, filename) {
		var a = document.createElement('a');
		a.download = filename;
		a.href = blob;
		// For Firefox https://stackoverflow.com/a/32226068
		document.body.appendChild(a);
		a.click();
		a.remove();
	}

	function in_array(needle, haystack, argStrict) {
		var key = '',
		strict = !! argStrict;

		//we prevent the double check (strict && arr[key] === ndl) || (!strict && arr[key] == ndl)
		//in just one for, in order to improve the performance 
		//deciding wich type of comparation will do before walk array
		if (strict) {
		for (key in haystack) {
			if (haystack[key] === needle) {
			return true;
			}
		}
		} else {
		for (key in haystack) {
			if (haystack[key] == needle) {
			return true;
			}
		}
		}

		return false;
	}

	function shuffle(array) {
		let currentIndex = array.length,  randomIndex;

		// While there remain elements to shuffle.
		while (currentIndex > 0) {

			// Pick a remaining element.
			randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * currentIndex);
			currentIndex--;

			// And swap it with the current element.
			[array[currentIndex], array[randomIndex]] = [
			array[randomIndex], array[currentIndex]];
		}

		return array;
	}

	function setCookie(cname, cvalue, extimeDays) {
		var d = new Date();
		d.setTime(d.getTime() + (extimeDays*86400*1000));
		var expires = "expires="+d.toGMTString();
		document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + "; " + expires+'; secure;domain=.'+location.hostname+';path=/; samesite=lax';
	}
	function getCookie(cname) {
		var name = cname + "=";
		var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
		for(var i=0; i<ca.length; i++) {
				var c = ca[i];
				while (c.charAt(0)==' ') c = c.substring(1);
				if (c.indexOf(name) != -1) return c.substring(name.length,c.length);
		}
		return "";
	}
	function str_replace(search, replace, subject, count) {
		var i = 0,
			j = 0,
			temp = '',
			repl = '',
			sl = 0,
			fl = 0,
			f = [].concat(search),
			r = [].concat(replace),
			s = subject,
			ra = Object.prototype.toString.call(r) === '[object Array]',
			sa = Object.prototype.toString.call(s) === '[object Array]';
		s = [].concat(s);
		if (count) {
			this.window[count] = 0;
		}

		for (i = 0, sl = s.length; i < sl; i++) {
			if (s[i] === '') {
				continue;
			}
			for (j = 0, fl = f.length; j < fl; j++) {
				temp = s[i] + '';
				repl = ra ? (r[j] !== undefined ? r[j] : '') : r[0];
				s[i] = (temp)
					.split(f[j])
					.join(repl);
				if (count && s[i] !== temp) {
					this.window[count] += (temp.length - s[i].length) / f[j].length;
				}
			}
		}
		return sa ? s : s[0];
	}

	function escapeHtml(text) {
		if(typeof text=='number') {
			var text=text.toString();
		}

		var map = {
			'&': '&',
			'<': '<',
			'>': '>',
			'"': '"',
			"'": '''
		};
		
		return text.replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) { return map[m]; });
	}

	function timeAgoShort(epoch) {
		var secs = ((new Date()).getTime() / 1000) - epoch;
		Math.floor(secs);
		var minutes = secs / 60;
		secs = Math.floor(secs % 60);
		if (minutes < 1) {
			return secs + (secs > 1 ? 's' : 's');
		}
		var hours = minutes / 60;
		minutes = Math.floor(minutes % 60);
		if (hours < 1) {
			return minutes + (minutes > 1 ? 'm' : 'm');
		}
		var days = hours / 24;
		hours = Math.floor(hours % 24);
		if (days < 1) {
			return hours + (hours > 1 ? 'h' : 'h');
		}
		/*var weeks = days / 7;
		days = Math.floor(days % 7);
		if (weeks < 1) {
			return days + (days > 1 ? 'd' : 'd');
		}
		var months = weeks / 4.35;
		weeks = Math.floor(weeks % 4.35);
		if (months < 1) {
			return weeks + (weeks > 1 ? 'w' : 'w');
		}*/
		var months = days / 30;
		days = Math.floor(days % 30);
		if (months < 1) {
			return days + (days > 1 ? 'd' : 'd');
		}
		var years = months / 12;
		months = Math.floor(months % 12);
		if (years < 1) {
			return months + (months > 1 ? 'mo' : 'mo');
		}
		years = Math.floor(years);
		return years + (years > 1 ? 'y' : 'y');
	}

	var pageTitleGeneratingTimer=null;
	var titleGenSeen={}; // photo_ids of the current generating batch, for the (3/5 done) title counter
	function waitForServerToGenerate(photo_id,what) {
		//
		// check every N seconds, if output_image_uid.json exists yet after requesting to generate it
		// the JSON contains the images
		//

		if(typeof photo_id==='undefined') {
			return;
		}

		titleGenSeen[photo_id]=1;

		if (pageTitleGeneratingTimer===null) {
			var dots = 0;
			pageTitleGeneratingTimer = setInterval(function() {
				dots = (dots + 1) % 4;
				var batchIds=Object.keys(titleGenSeen);
				var batchDone=batchIds.filter(function(id){ return loadingSpinnerPhotoIdsFinished[id]; }).length;
				var batchCounter=(batchIds.length>1) ? ' ('+batchDone+'/'+batchIds.length+' done)' : '';
				window.document.title = 'Generating' + '.'.repeat(dots) + batchCounter;
			}, 500);
		}

		// console.log('waitForServerToGenerate '+photo_id);
		polledServerCount[photo_id]++;


		// try N times then give up
		if(polledServerCount[photo_id]>5000) {
			// alert("Giving up, the AI API might be down, sometimes it's a bit unstable. Please try again in an hour! Upgrade to Pro and you can can come back later and your renders will show up when you reload the page in your own private workspace.");
			console.log('max polled, so stop trying now');
			// showStripeModal();
			$('.loading_spinner.main').hide();
			clearTimeout(loadingSpinnerTimeout);
			$('.loading_spinner .loading_message').text('');
			return;
		}

		var time=Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

		console.log(what);


		if(what=='poll_for_preprocessed') {
			var url='/assets/tmp/'+photo_id+'-pre.json?'+time;
		}
		else if(what=='poll_for_postprocessed') {
			var url='/assets/tmp/'+photo_id+'.json?'+time;
		}
		else if(what=='poll_for_auto_detect_clothes') {
			var url='/assets/tmp/'+photo_id+'-prompt.json?'+time;
			var val=$('div.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').val();
			if(val.indexOf('...')>-1) {
				$('.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').val('Analyzing clothes, this can take up to 30 seconds.');	
			}
			else if(val.indexOf('..')>-1) {
				$('.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').val('Analyzing clothes, this can take up to 30 seconds...');
			}
			else if(val.indexOf('.')>-1) {
				$('.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').val('Analyzing clothes, this can take up to 30 seconds..');
			}
		}
		else {
			alert("No poll for what in waitForServerToGenerate specified");
			return;
		}

		$.ajax({
			async:true,
			timeout: 3000,
			url: url,
			type: 'GET'
		}).done(function(photo) {

			if(what=='poll_for_auto_detect_clothes') {
				var prompt=photo;
				$('.loading_spinner.main').hide();

				if(prompt.prompt!='') {
					$('.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').val('(full body frontal photo) of model wearing '+prompt.prompt+'');
					$('.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').addClass('active');
				}

				autoDetectingPromptNow=false;
				// Remove auto-detecting animation class
				$('.sidebar textarea.manual_prompt').removeClass('auto-detecting');
				return;
			}


			if(photo['status']=='nsfw_detected') {
				// if we optimistically reserved this video's credits on submit, give them back
				window.refundReservedCredits(photo['photo_id']);
				alert("❌ "+(photo['error'] ? "Flagged: " + photo['error']+"\n\n" : "")+"Your photo was flagged by our API's content filter. You were not charged credits for this. This is not Photo AI's content filter by the way, it's our API's content filter.\n\nWe think AI content filters are a bit too strict and they have a lot of false positives, and we're trying to convince our API providers to be more chill.");
				$('.div_output_image.photo-'+photo['photo_id']).remove();
				return;
			}

			// <show finished image after>
				if(
					photo['status']=='finished' ||
					photo['status']=='nsfw_detected' /* if nsfw detected, also finish but don't show pic */
				) {
					// newly finished photo, add it
					console.log(photo['photo_id']+' is finished! adding to photos now');

					if(photo['status']=='finished') {
						if(photo.cost_in_credits && !window.settleReservedCredits(photo['photo_id'])) {
							// NOT already optimistically reserved (e.g. a photo) — decrement now.
							// (videos were reserved on submit; settleReservedCredits consumed it,
							// so we skip here to avoid double-charging the display.)
							// decrement user credits with cost of finished photo from the photo's cost_in_credits data
							if($('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits')-photo.cost_in_credits<0) {
								// Not enough regular credits, check extra credits
								var remainingCost = photo.cost_in_credits - $('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits');
								$('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits',0);
								
								if($('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits')-remainingCost<0) {
									$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits',0);
								} else {
									$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits',
										$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits')-remainingCost
									);
								}
								$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').text(number_format(
									$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').data('credits')
								));
								$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').addClass('glow');
								setTimeout(function() {
									$('.photoCreditsExtraLeft').removeClass('glow')
								},500);
							}
							else {
								$('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits',
									$('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits')-photo.cost_in_credits
								);
								$('.photoCreditsLeft').text(number_format(
									$('.photoCreditsLeft').data('credits')
								));
								$('.photoCreditsLeft').addClass('glow');
								setTimeout(function() {
									$('.photoCreditsLeft').removeClass('glow')
								},500);
							}
						}
					}

					if(photo['photo_id'].split('-')[2]==1){
						//
						// only get avg waiting time from the FIRST photo of the batch
						// cause they run sequentially so it doesn't make sense to show
						// avg waiting time for later ones
						//
						// videos update the VIDEO average + Make video button; they must NOT
						// poison the photo average (a finishing ~7min video was rewriting the
						// Take photo button to 6m50s and slowing the photo % estimate)
						//
						if(photo['video']) {
							// normalize the finished video's time to the 15s baseline via its
							// cost (cost = base/15s * duration, there is no duration column),
							// then re-render the button estimate scaled by the SELECTED length
							var videoCreditsBase=100;
							var finishedVideoDuration=(photo['video_duration']>0) ? Math.round(photo['video_duration']) : ((photo['cost_in_credits']>0) ? Math.round(photo['cost_in_credits']/videoCreditsBase*15) : 15);
							var closestVideoDuration=15;
							[5,10,15,30].forEach(function(d){ if(Math.abs(d-finishedVideoDuration)<Math.abs(closestVideoDuration-finishedVideoDuration)) closestVideoDuration=d; });
							avgVideoWaitingTime=Math.round((photo['epoch_finished']-photo['epoch_queued'])*15/closestVideoDuration);
							if(typeof updateMakeVideoButtonTime==='function') updateMakeVideoButtonTime();
						}
						else {
							// live-update the finished photo's OWN mode bucket; only touch the
							// button (and the global % basis) when it matches the selected mode,
							// so a finishing gpt image can't rewrite the estimate while on ultra
							var finishedMode=photo['gpt_image'] ? 'gpt_image' : (photo['ultra_realism'] ? 'ultra' : (photo['nano_banana'] ? 'nano' : (photo['realism'] ? 'hyper' : 'other')));
							var finishedTime=Math.round(photo['epoch_finished']-photo['epoch_queued']);
							if(avgWaitingTimeByMode) avgWaitingTimeByMode[finishedMode]=finishedTime;
							if(typeof getRealismMode!=='function' || getRealismMode()==finishedMode) {
								avgWaitingTime=finishedTime;
								$('.avgWaitingTime').text(formatAvgWaitingTime(avgWaitingTime));
							}
						}
					}

					var html=makePhotoBox(photo);
					
					// replace placeholder for specific photo with photo that's done
					$('.div_output_image.photo-'+photo['photo_id']).replaceWith(html);
					// $('.div_output_image.photo-'+photo['photo_id']).remove();
					// $('.div_output_images').prepend(html);

					// set finished so spinner stops
					loadingSpinnerPhotoIdsFinished[photo_id]=true;

					// check if all images are done and we can unlock take photo button
					if(
						!$('.div_output_images .div_output_image.placeholder').length &&
						!$('.div_output_images .div_output_image.postprocessing').length &&
						!$('.div_output_images .div_output_image.processing').length
					) {
						$('.action-take-photo').removeClass('disabled');
						$('html').removeClass('taking-photos');
						
						// play sound if all jobs are finished
						if(
							!isMobile &&
							document.hidden && // if user is not in the tab now, play sound
							$('.play_sound_on_finish').val()=='yes'
						) {
							var audio = new Audio('/assets/alert2.mp3');
							audio.play();
						}

						// set title back to original
						if (!document.hidden) {
							window.document.title = originalPageTitle;
						} else {
							window.document.title = 'Done!';
						}

						clearInterval(pageTitleGeneratingTimer);
						pageTitleGeneratingTimer=null;
						titleGenSeen={}; // batch finished — next generation starts a fresh count

					}
				}
			// </show finished image after>



		}).fail(function(reply) {
			// alert("error");
			// console.log('FAIL Poll try #'+polledServerCount[photo_id]+', not yet ready for '+photo_id);

							setTimeout(waitForServerToGenerate,(pollIntervalTime*2*Math.random()),photo_id,what);

	async function preprocessImageFromFileUploader(fileIndex) {					
		// console.log('=============');
		console.log('processing image #'+fileIndex);

		var totalFiles = $('.input_training_uploader')[0].files.length;

		trainingResolution=1024;

		$('.div_training_uploader .loading_spinner').show();
		$('.div_training_uploader .loading_spinner .loading_message').show();
		$('.div_training_uploader .loading_spinner .loading_message').text(
			(fileIndex+1)+'/'+totalFiles
		);
		$('.div_training_uploader_center').hide();

		// <process image>
			var file=$('.input_training_uploader')[0].files[fileIndex];
			// console.log(file.name);

			var fileReader = new FileReader();

			if(typeof file==='undefined') {
				// not a good file, skip
				console.log('Bad file: '+(typeof file));
				// preprocessImageFromFileUploader(fileIndex+1);
				return;
			}

			fileReader.readAsDataURL(file);

			fileReader.onload = function () {

				console.log('#'+fileIndex+' fileReader.onload');

				// <flux>
					var img = document.createElement('img');
					img.src = fileReader.result;

					$('.div_training_uploader .img_training').attr('src',fileReader.result);

					img.onerror = async function() {
						console.log('#'+fileIndex+' error creating img object, skipping photo');
						preprocessImageFromFileUploader(fileIndex+1);
						return;
					}

					img.onload = async function() {
						var maxWidth = 1024;
						var maxHeight = 1024;
						
						var width = img.width;
						var height = img.height;
						
						if (width > height) {
							if (width > maxWidth) {
								height *= maxWidth / width;
								width = maxWidth;
							}
						} else {
							if (height > maxHeight) {
								width *= maxHeight / height;
								height = maxHeight;
							}
						}

						var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
						canvas.width = width;
						canvas.height = height;
						
						var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
						ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
						
						var dataURL = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg');

						$('.div_training_uploader .samples').append('<img class="sample" src="'+dataURL+'" />');

						var blob = await new Promise(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve,'image/jpeg'));
						filesToUploadBlobs.push(blob);

						// <auto-detect model attributes for first image>
						if (fileIndex === 0 && blob) {
							// Trigger auto-detection using the first uploaded image
							autoDetectModelAttributes(blob);
						}
						// </auto-detect model attributes for first image>

						// <if done all quit>
							if(fileIndex>=(totalFiles-1)) {
								// done all pics, start uploading here?
								console.log('Done! Processed '+totalFiles+', of which '+filesToUploadBlobs.length+' passed');
								$('.div_training_uploader').addClass('primed');
								$('.action-train-model').removeClass('disabled');
								$('.div_training_uploader .loading_spinner').hide();
								$('.div_training_uploader').css('background-image','');
								$('.div_training_uploader').removeClass('active');
								$('.div_training_uploader_center').show();
								
								// if we here, all good
								// set train button to blinking
								$('.action-train-model').addClass('blinking');
							}
							else {
								// more pics to do! do next pic
								console.log('Now have '+(filesToUploadBlobs.length)+' usable photos');
								preprocessImageFromFileUploader(fileIndex+1)
							}
						// </if done all quit>

					}
				// <flux>
			}
		// </process image>

	}

	// <auto-detect model attributes function>
		function autoDetectModelAttributes(imageBlob) {
			// Only auto-detect for real person models, not AI influencers
			if ($('.select_create_model_real_or_ai').val() === 'ai_influencer') {
				return;
			}

			// Show loading indicator
			$('.training_p').before('<div class="model-auto-detect-loading">🤖 Analyzing images to detect model attributes...</div>');
			
			// Prepare FormData for the request
			var formData = new FormData();
			formData.append('image', imageBlob, 'training_image.jpg');

			// Make AJAX request to auto-detection endpoint
			$.ajax({
				url: '/auto_detect_features',
				type: 'POST',
				data: formData,
				processData: false,
				contentType: false,
				dataType: 'json',
				timeout: 30000,
				success: function(response) {
					$('.model-auto-detect-loading').remove();
					
					if (response.success) {
						// Auto-populate form fields with detected values
						// but only if they're not set yet
						if (response.name && $('.input_create_model_name').val() === '') {
							$('.input_create_model_name').val(response.name);
						}
						if (response.gender && $('.select_create_model_gender').val() === '') {
							$('.select_create_model_gender').val(response.gender);
						}
						if (response.age && $('.input_create_model_age').val() === '') {
							$('.input_create_model_age').val(response.age);
						}
						if (response.ethnicity && $('.select_create_model_ethnicity').val() === '') {
							$('.select_create_model_ethnicity').val(response.ethnicity);
						}
						if (response.eye_color && $('.select_create_model_eye_color').val() === '') {
							$('.select_create_model_eye_color').val(response.eye_color);
						}
						if (response.hair_bald && $('.select_create_model_hair_bald').val() === '') {
							$('.select_create_model_hair_bald').val(response.hair_bald);
						}
						
						// Add visual feedback
						$('.training_p').before('<div class="model-auto-detect-success">✅ Model attributes auto-detected! You can modify them above if you want.</div>');
						setTimeout(function() {
							$('.model-auto-detect-success').fadeOut(function() {
								$(this).remove();
							});
						}, 5000);
					} else {
						console.log('Auto-detection failed:', response);
					}
				},
				error: function(xhr, status, error) {
					$('.auto-detect-loading').remove();
					console.log('Auto-detection error:', error);
					// Fail silently - user can fill manually
				}
			});
		}

			.split('.');
		if (s[0].length > 3) {

<script>
(function() {
    var targetTime = 1787745600000;
    function updateCountdown() {
        var now = new Date().getTime();
        var distance = targetTime - now;
        if (distance < 0) {
            document.querySelector('.countdown-timer-bar').style.display = 'none';
            document.querySelector('.header').style.top = '0';
            document.body.style.paddingTop = '60px';
            var h = document.querySelector('.hero'); if(h) h.style.marginTop = '0';
            return;
        }
        var days = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        var hours = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
        var minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
        var seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-days-tens').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = Math.floor(days / 10);});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-days-ones').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = days % 10;});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-hours-tens').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = Math.floor(hours / 10);});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-hours-ones').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = hours % 10;});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-minutes-tens').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = Math.floor(minutes / 10);});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-minutes-ones').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = minutes % 10;});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-seconds-tens').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = Math.floor(seconds / 10);});
        document.querySelectorAll('.td-seconds-ones').forEach(function(el){el.textContent = seconds % 10;});
    }
    updateCountdown();
    setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);

        }
    };
})();

			(function() {
				var gridColsMap = [8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1];
				var slider = document.querySelector('.grid_size_slider');
				var savedGrid = localStorage.getItem('grid-cols');
				if(savedGrid) {

						slider.value = idx + 1;
						document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-grid-cols', savedGrid);
						document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--grid-cols', savedGrid);
					}
				}
				// On 1-col view (1 photo per row) load the original photo_url from R2 with no CDN resize.
				// data-src = original R2 url (set at render time)
				// data-cdn-src = the resized CDN url we swapped out (cached for restore)
				window.applyFullSizeForOneCol = function() {
					var gridCols = parseInt(document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-grid-cols')||'0', 10);
					var images = document.querySelectorAll('.div_output_image .output_image');
					if(gridCols === 1) {
						images.forEach(function(img) {
							var dataSrc = img.getAttribute('data-src');
							if(!dataSrc) return;
							var currentSrc = img.getAttribute('src') || '';
							if(currentSrc === dataSrc) return;
							if(!img.getAttribute('data-cdn-src')) {
								img.setAttribute('data-cdn-src', currentSrc);
							}
							img.setAttribute('src', dataSrc);
						});
					} else {
						images.forEach(function(img) {
							var cdnSrc = img.getAttribute('data-cdn-src');
							if(!cdnSrc) return;
							if(img.getAttribute('src') !== cdnSrc) {
								img.setAttribute('src', cdnSrc);
							}
						});
					}
				};
				slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
					var cols = gridColsMap[parseInt(this.value) - 1];
					document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-grid-cols', cols);
					document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--grid-cols', cols);
					localStorage.setItem('grid-cols', cols);
					window.applyFullSizeForOneCol();
				});
				// run once at load in case savedGrid is 1
				window.applyFullSizeForOneCol();
			})();

			<script>
				var photoPackSearchQuery='';
				var photoPackCategory='';

				function filterPhotoPacks() {
					if(selectedFolder!='templates') return;

					var query = $('.photo_pack_search').val().toLowerCase();
					var category = $('.photo_pack_category').val();
					var $container = $('.div_output_images.templates');
					var $templates = $container.find('.div_template');

					if(query == '' && category == '') {
						$templates.show();
						return;
					}

					var matches = [];

					$templates.each(function() {
						var $el = $(this);
						var name = ($el.data('name') || '').toLowerCase();
						var desc = ($el.data('description') || '').toLowerCase();
						var elCategory = $el.data('category') || '';

						// Check category filter first
						if(category && elCategory != category) {
							$el.hide();
							return;
						}

						// If no search query, just show (category already matched)
						if(query == '') {
							matches.push({ el: $el, score: 0, name: name });
							return;
						}

						var score = -1;
						if(name === query) {
							score = 0;
						} else if(name.indexOf(query) === 0) {
							score = 1;
						} else if(name.indexOf(query) > -1) {
							score = 2;
						} else if(desc.indexOf(query) > -1) {
							score = 3;
						}

						if(score >= 0) {
							matches.push({ el: $el, score: score, name: name });
						} else {
							$el.hide();
						}
					});

					matches.sort(function(a, b) {
						if(a.score !== b.score) return a.score - b.score;
						return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
					});

					matches.forEach(function(item) {
						item.el.detach().appendTo($container).show();
					});
				}

				$(function() {
					$('.photo_pack_search').bind('keyup',function(event) {
						if(photoPackSearchQuery==$(this).val()) return;
						photoPackSearchQuery=$(this).val();
						filterPhotoPacks();
					});

					$('.photo_pack_category').bind('change',function() {
						photoPackCategory=$(this).val();
						filterPhotoPacks();
					});
				});
